Name: Common Birds - PNW Birds for Ornithologist's Guild
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Hello! This is a simple bird pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Ornithologist's Guild[/url].[/center]
[center]It adds 16 bird species (male and female) that are commonly found in the western U.S., and the PNW specifically.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]These birdies are meant to match the vanilla game, but were specifically made with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39616]Em's Critters[/url] in mind.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Additionally, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48918]Trolley[/url] installed, the birds will show in their respective ecosystems. [/center]

[center]This was really fun to make so expect some more birds in the future. Thanks all![/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Thank you to GCWA, who's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26976]warbler pack[/url] has been my birding go-to, and who's mod was incredibly helpful for understanding how these bird packs work.[/center]
[center]And of course, thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Ivy[/url] for making such an amazing birding framework![/center]
